blacklistabilityReview.evidence: tGBP's material deployments are Ethereum (71.6171%) and Base (26.9206%), both at 0x27f6c8289550fce67f6b50bed1f519966afe5287; Solana is 0.8128% and does not set the verdict. At Ethereum block 26224768 (2026-10-19T06:15:47Z) the proxy resolves to verified StableTokenV1OFT 0x94321d80d3c5cdac63b75f723ae64ca7f94be547 and owner() is 0xAF4fCE2984Fb307a368f3Ff01f900909956595C0; the same owner is set on Base at block 52800656 (2026-10-19T06:17:39Z), where isBanned(address) also resolves. The source's Bannable base lets the owner ban/unban a named account, and transfer, transferFrom, mint and burn apply notBanned checks; the contract also exposes owner-only pause/unpause and UUPS upgrades. An active owner can therefore stop a named holder from transferring on material deployments. The previously cited Solana freeze authority 3NsEdxXZX6QXNtZT2prWQF2c8VFznc9zK1A2BjzAMyjs (finalized slot 452213538) remains disclosed as sub-threshold.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: tGBP has issuer-native StableTokenV1OFT deployments on Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Gnosis, and Arc plus an issuer-native Solana SPL mint. LayerZero V2 supplies a separate direct OFT burn/mint mesh: EVM owners configure peers and bridge options, while the Solana OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb is one signer of the 1-of-2 mint multisig for inbound bridge credits. The shared EVM owner can mint, pause and configure OFT peers on all eight EVM deployments, and authorize upgrades through the ProxyAdmin it owns on seven of them (Avalanche's ProxyAdmin is self-owned), without a verified immutable numeric ceiling, so its bridge cap semantics are conservatively raiseable. LayerZero Scan observations of the Solana-to-Ethereum route show V302, ten confirmations, three required DVNs, and a route-specific executor, so that route is externally validated; Arc uses a different Endpoint V2, has no Avalanche or Gnosis peer, and its DVN quorum is unknown pending evidence. Direct native minting remains independently scored under Mint Authority.

controls.label: tGBP EVM LayerZero OFT owner bridge controls

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: LayerZero V2 direct OFT burn/mint: source transfers debit or burn tGBP and destination transfers credit or mint tGBP. No independent lockbox or escrow was identified.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At the 2026-08-16 reads, the Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Gnosis StableTokenV1OFT deployments used Endpoint V2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c with nonzero peers to one another plus the Solana OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb. Arc uses Endpoint V2 0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b; at Arc block 33495162 its peers resolved to the Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon and Arbitrum deployments and the Solana OFT Store, while its Avalanche and Gnosis peers were zero. The owner can replace setPeer configuration and enforced options on every deployment.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: LayerZero Scan observations of the Solana-to-Ethereum route show V302 with ten confirmations, three required DVNs (LayerZero Labs, Nethermind, and Google), no optional DVNs, no optional threshold, and a route-specific executor; that route is externally validated by this DVN stack. Arc's DVN configuration and quorum were not observed and are unknown pending evidence.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Exact live remaining token-specific route quotas were not available from the reviewed OFT interfaces; the LayerZero Scan observations provide active DVN and executor configuration, not those remaining quotas.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The common issuer EOA controls owner-only bridge surfaces including setPeer, enforced options, Endpoint delegate/OApp configuration and pause/unpause on the eight EVM OFT deployments, including Arc (owner re-verified at Arc block 33493732). Upgrades are a separate control (tgbp-evm-proxyadmin-upgrade) on the seven deployments whose ProxyAdmin the EOA owns; Avalanche's ProxyAdmin is self-owned. These bridge capabilities are separate from its native owner-only mint/burn capability.
routeChecks.signingModel: The EVM bridge controller is the issuer EOA 0xAF4fCE2984Fb307a368f3Ff01f900909956595C0; no Safe, timelock, module, guard, or delay was verified.

controls.capDescription: No aggregate bridge mint cap was verified; OFT route-level conservation is supplied by source debit/burn and destination credit/mint, not by a native issuance cap.
controls.evidence: At the 2026-08-16 observations (Ethereum block 25771292, Base 50069042, BSC 116370461, Polygon 92148275, Avalanche 92987083, Arbitrum 495314108, and Gnosis 47763307), owner() on each of those seven EVM StableTokenV1OFT deployments returned issuer EOA 0xAF4fCE2984Fb307a368f3Ff01f900909956595C0 and endpoint() returned LayerZero Endpoint V2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c; their peers bound them to one another and to the Solana OFT Store. At Arc block 33493732 (2026-11-27) owner() returned the same EOA and endpoint() returned Endpoint V2 0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b; at Arc block 33495162 its peers resolved to Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum and the Solana OFT Store, with zero Avalanche and Gnosis peers. The owner's setPeer, enforced-options, endpoint delegate/OApp and pause surfaces are bridge machinery, and its ProxyAdmin upgrade path is recorded separately for the seven deployments where it owns the ProxyAdmin; native direct mint/burn remains separately authored in Mint Authority. A recent Solana-to-Ethereum LayerZero message delivered on Ethereum block 25753011 used ULN V302, ten confirmations, required LayerZero Labs, Nethermind, and Google DVNs, no optional DVNs or optional threshold, and a route-specific executor. That quorum is evidenced for the observed route only; Arc's DVN quorum is unknown pending evidence.

controls.label: tGBP Solana OFT destination mint-authority multisig

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: LayerZero Solana OFT credit is a direct bridge burn/mint route; no independent lockbox or escrow was identified.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Solana slot 439747729, the 1-of-2 SPL Token Program multisig signers were the LayerZero OFT Store 9hbekmg6j6YFpuYcDoJJovndnNkBaVayzKZuAWaX6dLb and an additional issuer signer. The Store is the route-bound bridge signer; the second signer means the token-level authority also remains a native issuer control.
routeChecks.caps: No numeric SPL mint or bridge route cap was verified. Because the multisig threshold is 1, the Store can participate in inbound bridge credit minting; the additional issuer signer is a separate token-level mint surface outside the LayerZero route.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The multisig is both the native Solana mint/freeze authority and a bridge boundary. Its native direct mint capability remains in Mint Authority; this control scores only the Store-backed bridge mint capability.

controls.capDescription: No numeric SPL mint cap was verified; the 1-of-2 authority can authorize bridge credits without an on-chain amount ceiling.
bypassSurfaces: The additional issuer signer can participate in SPL Token Program minting outside LayerZero route validation; operational separation from bridge credits is not proven.
